create_flux_kontext_pipeline: create a FluxKontextPipeline instance for image-to-image and text-to-image generation with FLUX.1-Kontext-dev model
run_flux_kontext_generation: run the FluxKontextPipeline __call__ method to generate images from a prompt and reference image with guidance scale
encode_flux_kontext_prompt: encode text prompts into T5 and CLIP embeddings using FluxKontextPipeline encode_prompt method
prepare_flux_kontext_latents: prepare latent variables from input images using FluxKontextPipeline prepare_latents with packing and image ID generation
calculate_flux_kontext_shift: calculate the shift parameter for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
